title: Hermes Resident Qualification
objective: Qualify the repo-proven Hermes universal communications contracts against current V2 Command Deck, Trust Canal, Work, Talos, Keymaster and Mycelium ownership before any House admission or channel integration.
laws: Hermes is infrastructure, not a Titan.
Hermes may own universal communications acceptance/tracking/delivery semantics but never planning or product WORK.
Trust Canal remains the authority/admission boundary for consequential intents; Hermes cannot become a second approval authority.
Work remains canonical orchestration projection; Talos remains execution verification/retry truth.
Keymaster owns credential semantics; Hermes carries no raw secrets or secret resolution.
Channel adapters cannot bypass Hermes into Titans, Talos, shell or workers.
No live external channel, network provider, credential, database, scheduler or mutation execution is added by qualification.
Nyx introspection is harvested into existing Talos/Housekeeping/Mnemosyne audit surfaces; no standalone Nyx resident is created.
